items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to out for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; Ravens WR hierarchy shifts.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to remaining WRs and TEs.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to out for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.implication: Houston WR volume opens; Schultz TE bump.

items.text: ETR Rundown for Week 2 is live: game-by-game written review of content including projections, matchups, cheap WR volume.
Rams officially listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants due to hip injury (groin soreness per McVay); Jordan Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.why: Hip/groin soreness after Thursday practice; DNP Sat; GTD likely.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; TE heavier usage if out.
items.opportunity: If out, routes to TEs Ferguson/Parkinson and other WRs.

items.text: With Joe Burrow listed questionable for Sunday at Houston, Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson from practice squad.
items.why: Back; elevated backup but expected to play per reports.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; likely ACTIVE and startable.
items.opportunity: Full snaps if active; Chase/Higgins unaffected.

items.text: With TE Brock Bowers doubtful for Sunday, Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White from practice squad.
items.why: Knee; limited practice Friday, elevated backup.
items.implication: Expect OUT; plan TE alternative. Plan for Myarick/Mayer usage.
items.opportunity: TE snaps/targets to elevated Myarick or Michael Mayer.

items.text: Berry on Nacua Q: If Puka misses, expect heavier TE usage (Ferguson & Parkinson); biggest WR bump to Konata Mumpfield (if Whittington also out). Have pivot ready.
items.why: DNP second straight day; different injury from camp.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) questionable; ETR notes Quentin Johnston and Tre’ Harris secured high target shares post-McConkey exit in Wk1 and project 5+ targets, larger roles vs Raiders if out.
items.why: Rib; limited Fri after DNPs; status impacts Herbert ceiling.
items.implication: Monitor inactives; QJ/Harris upgrade if OUT.
items.opportunity: High route/target share to QJ/Harris if McConkey inactive.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (team lead); IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite early-down + pass-game usage; soft run matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Wk1 (tied Bijan league lead), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3/4 recent.
items.why: Near-100 util + consistent pass involvement vs soft LAC.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util score Wk1, 26% target share, all RB RZ touches; CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Pass-game + goal-line monopoly + soft run D.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Wk1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further as underdogs.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara return; poor script.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Wk1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs.
items.why: Massive volume with Wentz; favorable matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Wk1; TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR to Jets WRs.
Berry LOVES Dalton Kincaid vs DET: top-5 TE util Wk1, 69% route rate (higher than any 2025 game); DET allowed 27 FPts to TEs.
Berry HATES Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: 8% target share Wk1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA tough vs WRs.
Berry LOVES Dak Prescott vs WAS: 21.3 PPG home last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Wk1; high implied total.
items.why: Home smash spot vs porous secondary + high total.
